subject: Lunch Menu Change - Week of May 11
text_body:
Dear Lincoln Families,

We want to inform you of a change to the lunch menu for the week of May 11-15, 2026.

Due to a supply chain issue with our chicken supplier, we need to make the following substitutions:

REVISED MENU - Week of May 11:

Monday, May 11:
- ORIGINAL: Chicken nuggets, mashed potatoes, green beans
- REVISED: Fish sticks, mashed potatoes, green beans

Tuesday, May 12:
- ORIGINAL: Chicken teriyaki bowl, steamed rice, edamame
- REVISED: Beef teriyaki bowl, steamed rice, edamame

Wednesday, May 13:
- ORIGINAL: Chicken Caesar salad, dinner roll
- REVISED: Turkey Caesar salad, dinner roll

Thursday and Friday menus remain unchanged.

As always, our salad bar and vegetarian options are available daily as alternatives. If your child has any food allergies or dietary restrictions that may be affected by these changes, please contact our kitchen manager, Ms. Rosa, at rosa.garcia@lincolnelementary.edu or (650) 555-0149.

We apologize for any inconvenience and expect to return to our regular menu the following week.

Thank you for your understanding.

Lincoln Elementary Cafeteria Staff
